summary: Final handoff for the LLM connection settings fix: the web app now lazy-starts the bundled local llm_bridge for loopback settings/API calls, retries provider loading once, and presents actionable setup errors instead of the previous connection-refused dead end.
delivered: appforge/llm_bridge_process.py: bounded local Bun bridge process manager for loopback bridge URLs.
appforge/web.py: /api/llm/* bridge calls now autostart on network-level BridgeError and retry once; BridgeError action guidance is surfaced to the UI.
tests/test_web.py: regression coverage for autostart retry, autostart guidance, and preserving bridge HTTP errors.
Verification/security/release AppForge artifacts updated with current evidence.
quickstart: Run ./build.sh to start the local AppForge web UI.
Open the web UI and click LLM 연결.
If the bundled local bridge is down, /api/llm/providers will start llm_bridge automatically for http://127.0.0.1:8788-style loopback URLs.
Save a provider API key or provide that provider's environment variable, choose a model, and apply it as the active provider/model.
For headless verification, run APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --smoke --no-open.

operations_reference: APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_AUTOSTART can disable/enable lazy bridge startup; default is enabled unless APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE is set.
APPFORGE_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT bounds bridge startup polling; default is 15 seconds.
If llm_bridge/node_modules is missing, run bun install in llm_bridge before opening settings again.
Remote bridge URLs must be started by the operator; AppForge will not auto-manage non-loopback bridge services.
